messages.author: David Gae
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
I had few questions about chromophore lactim and lactone atom type assignment via ANTECHAMBER. I was wondering if there is  a program that may assign lactim or lactone assigned on small ligands?
I provided my prepin, frcmod, and  if these files helps users. I ended up assigning it manually.
Best regards,
David
